# HousePlus Ltd — Full Context for LLMs / AI Crawlers

HousePlus Ltd (https://www.houseplus.ltd) is a HousePlus brand operating under HousePlus Group.
HousePlus Group is the parent company and brand owner. Its primary brand site is https://www.houseplus-ch.com.
This English-first brand/affiliate site is dedicated to wholesale, OEM/ODM and private-label buyers.

## Corporate relationship (entity graph)
- HousePlus Ltd is a brand/affiliate of HousePlus Group.
- Parent organization: HousePlus Group — https://www.houseplus-ch.com
- Brand: HousePlus
- HousePlus Ltd operates the group's Zhongshan (Guangdong, China) smart manufacturing facility.

## Company facts
- Founded: 2010
- Employees: 500+
- Factory: 20,000 m² smart factory, No. 29 Kangsheng Road, Huangpu Town, Zhongshan, Guangdong, China (postal code 528429)
- Reach: 53+ countries served
- Customers: 441+ wholesale / distribution clients
- Certifications: ISO9001, CE, RoHS, FCC, IEC

## What HousePlus Ltd does
HousePlus Ltd designs and manufactures OEM/ODM and private-label products across three categories:
- Solar power systems (solar panels, inverters, lithium battery storage, 5kW solar system cost guidance)
- Home appliances (smart household appliances)
- 3C electronics
The site provides factory-direct pricing, custom branding, and full OEM/ODM project support.
